# apicurio_artifact_types (Data Source)

The artifact types this registry supports (`GET /admin/config/artifactTypes`): the built-in ones (`AVRO`, `PROTOBUF`, `JSON`, `OPENAPI`, `ASYNCAPI`, `GRAPHQL`, `KCONNECT`, `WSDL`, `XSD`, `XML`), the ones newer versions add and any custom type the instance registers. `apicurio_artifact.artifact_type` is validated against this list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The artifact types this registry accepts (built-in and custom).
data "apicurio_artifact_types" "all" {}

output "supports_protobuf" {
  value = contains(data.apicurio_artifact_types.all.types, "PROTOBUF")
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The registry URL.
- `types` (List of String) Type names, in the registry's order.
